qualifications: First four idle samples: terminal prompt, 1472x834, no agent.
Later idle pair: 1201x834, sidebar filter caret focused after Settings; different workload from initial idle.
Animation on-a has composer focus; off and on-b have sidebar filter focus. Use off/on-b as closer pair; order and other desktop load were not controlled.
One edge drag changed width but recorded only one resize callback; sustained continuous-resize cadence remains unmeasured.
Sidebar CPU sample has 131/293 foreground observations and contains first two drags only; final drag occurs outside CPU window.
Composer sample includes stream and about 19.5 seconds after producer completion. Three software-latency pairs do not establish per-frame text identity or population percentiles.
First-dirty task containment identifies initial frame invalidation only; it does not assign all coalesced notifications or entity IDs.
Analysis and restart verification ran after samples, with no app-code or probe changes.
